messages:
Maya: Quick design check — new credentials grid row mock uploaded: https://figma.com/file/xxxx/credential-grid Maya: Main concerns: - rotate vs revoke visibility (should rotate be inline?) - empty state guidance & permission hints - warning copy for revokes that affect integrations - keyboard nav & screen reader announcements Omar: I lean toward an overflow menu for revoke; rotate is used more often, so maybe keep rotate as quick action (icon-only) + revoke inside menu. Omar: Implementation note: use a menu button with aria-haspopup and keyboard arrow handling. Omar: Example snippet: ```
  • Rotate
  • Revoke
``` Priya: Product callout: rotate is common in self-serve flows, agree to surface it. Priya: We should surface permission scope badge (Org / Project / Key-level) next to the key name. Priya: On rotate: show one-time plaintext with copy button, emphasize "you'll see this secret only once". Chen: Accessibility nits: - When showing secret, open a modal with role="dialog" and aria-modal="true"; focus trap inside. - Announce via live region: "Secret displayed, press Ctrl+C to copy". - Warning colors: ensure contrast >= 4.5:1 (current yellow fails). - Menu must support arrow keys + Home/End. Sam: Design thoughts: try compact row with icon-only rotate + overflow; tooltips on focus. Sam: Empty state: include quick CTA "Create first credential" + a short explainer and a link to docs. Omar: Implementation detail: we can render secret plaintext briefly in DOM, but remove after 5s; add an aria-live polite region for screen readers. Omar: Example live region: ```
// when secret revealed: document.getElementById('sr-notice').textContent = 'Secret shown. Copy now.' ``` Maya: Updated copy suggestion for revoke warning: "This key is referenced by active integrations. Revoking it may interrupt those integrations." Less scary but still clear. Priya: +1 on copy. Also we need audit events: credential.rotate, credential.revoke, credential.copy_secret. deploy-bot: deploy: mock uploaded by @Maya — asset 1862345678-updated-rotate-layout.png :art: Chen: Approve with one nit: use --color-warning-700 for banner, and ensure modal has aria-describedby pointing to the warning text. Maya: I'll push the Figma updates and export new assets. Thanks everyone! :sparkles:
